name: Penumbra
quote: Dark feathers fall under the hunter's moon as screams echo through the buildings.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Morning, Professor. Never would have taken you for one to also sleep so little. Me? I only require brief rest to recover lost energy and have no need for lengthy periods of sleep. For me, sleep is a purely redundant design element.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Take a break? The battlefield is no place for such words. A moment of inattentiveness means being dead a thousand times over... oh, we're in the Oasis.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Take care, Professor. Countless threats lurk in the night and forces lie in wait as we speak. Fear not, for I will always be in your shadow, watching over you.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Zzz... zzzz... gah! That was merely feigned sleep for the purpose of deceiving the enemy. My guard was not down for even a second! Damn, the atmosphere of ease in the Oasis must have influenced me. If this continues, I'll become a sniveling ne'er-do-well, idling the day away. Please take it easy, Professor. You may leave the rest to me.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Do you really care about my past, Professor? They're certainly not memories I enjoy reflecting upon. If you are truly interested, though, I would be willing to tell you about it.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Where are you going? Will it be dangerous? When will you be back? ...For the sake of safety, you ought to bring me along.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Don't mind where my eyes wander. It's all for the sake of your safety. Please ignore me, as if I was nothing more than a little woodland critter.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Are you sure hide-and-seek is your game of choice, Professor? To test my professionalism with a game is a perilous venture.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Halt! The blade's sharp. Please take care.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Ahh... That makes me itch a little. No, you may continue if you'd like.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Hngh... What a strange sensation.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: As commanded.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Penumbra reporting. I shall be your shadow, cleaving apart that which blocks your path. Where this blade goes, death follows.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: This edge sharpens by the day...

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: The smell of blood thickens...

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Night falls with a new moon, and my blade is eager. Who is my next target?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Assignment confirmed.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Pay what you owe.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: A traceless shadow, a methodical blade...

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: I need no additional accolades, save your praise.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Nothing deserving of praise.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Gah... I miscalculated...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Is this what you desire, Professor? Truth be told, from the day I was brought back to the Oasis, I have awaited this moment. Now that it is upon me, it seems so surreal, not unlike dreams of the battlefield. Know that no matter the time or place, this blade in my hand shall be at your service. Allow me to be your shadow, always by your side.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. Today is a day to be happy and I've made some signature dishes of mine for you. Take, for example, this pan-fried to-may-to with a side of to-mah-to, dedicated to the liveliness and pomp of the Oasis in this new year... Those two are the same vegetable? Impossible! They even sound different!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Snacks I've not encountered before... gah! Too sweet! Cough... This syrupy sensation will erode away at a warrior's neural cloud. Professor, why gift me these... chocolates? Sweets that represent love? ...Ah, forget what I said. I suddenly have a mind to keep the rest of these for collection.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: A dazzling sea of stars... I can't say I've seen a sight like this in recent memory. If I wasn't here at the Oasis, chances are that I'd never have gotten the time to look up and gaze at the stars. Spending such time with you, Professor... seems so indulgent.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: The chaos of a crowd buries killing intent. Please be careful, Professor. This is a celebration? Even if you say so, I will be sure to pay very, close, attention, to each and every person around... Sorry, I let myself go to a dark place briefly. If you find it appropriate, I shall put on the mask you... um... Professor, do you have a mask that isn't so... cute...

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Professor. Sorry, the firewood resisted all attempts at ignition, and the fireplace unironically remains dim and cold. If it is cold, you may maintain body temperature by coming within close vicinity of me. You see, Professor... I cannot move. The Christmas tree... it's been chopped into firewood. I am bound to stand in its place...

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy Birthday, Professor. Time takes no prisoners in its universal war and you seem to weather its winds better and better. If you are light, then Penumbra shall be the shadow that follows. I shall be happy to attend you in all your forms, never straying.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: My most sincere apologies for starting a fire in the kitchen the last time I was there. You may deduct the necessary repair fees from my pay. I never would have imagined that kitchens rejected physical laws in such a manner. To think that water would fail to put out a fire inside a pan... Huh? Oil fires can't be put out with water? I see how it is, someone must have placed a hazard in your vicinity with the goal of harming you! I've failed... To allow such threats to be in your proximity...

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: I do not like hide-and-seek. When I hide too well, the others tend to leave me behind. "As if we're going to find that guy. Whatever, this is getting boring." You happen to be the first person to easily find me, Professor. I wonder why that is? My cloak slipped out? No... wait, hang on... that wasn't meant to happen.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Gah... Tch... My old wounds are flaring up. They sting a bit on rainy days. No need for you to worry about them, Professor. I can have the damaged parts replaced at the medical Department? Thank you for the offer, but I fear that without the pain to remind me of my past, I would fall into the mires of complacency... You've given me sanctuary, and I have little to fear here at the Oasis. This almost self-destructive way of reminding myself has no doubt lost its original meaning... but I do not want to forget that meaning. And... if I was to have something I desire even less to forget, how am I to create a mark to remind myself of that...

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: An old friend here? You mean Simo? Ah... Perhaps friend is not the correct word, but I would be grateful if you were to arrange for me to work with him further... Cough, I desire power and admire those who are strong. To want to work alongside the legendary Gaul makes sense, no? ...In truth, perhaps I am simply clawing at the shadows of the past that cling onto him. Both of our pasts... are whited out. Regardless, it is you that granted us what we hold in our hands and can look to in the future. I shall answer that with nothing less than utmost loyalty, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: Things I want to do? ...Worry not, Professor, I've no mind to do anything other than follow you. I was once forced into the shadows by the virtue of my status as an assassin, but you've brought me into the light. I know well what I am doing. I obey not the orders of another, but the voice inside my heart. All that I wish is to keep you safe and sound, no matter what circumstances you find yourself in.

career:
OpsTec is a series of military test Dolls developed by Svarog Heavy Industries with the primary purpose of putting optical camouflage technology through combat testing. This technology is undergoing small-scale testing in the middle of its research, and it has only been provided to a limited amount of elite specialist units employed in special operations, espionage, and assassination scenarios. Despite nominally being a Doll created for the purpose of technical testing belonging to the company, the singular existing OpsTec model was provided to a certain military magnate, and participated in a series of secretive missions under their command.

With that magnate's deposition during a conflict in 2057, the OpsTec model now dubbed "Penumbra" was retrieved by Svarog and provided to Project Neural Cloud afterwards. Despite unforeseen circumstances arising, the model passed the Project's tests.
infoStories:
Research relevant to optical camouflage capable of concealing combatants and equipment in an operational environment began in the era of the Cold War, but only made meaningful progress in the middle of the 21st century. Due to their as of yet incomplete state and tremendous costs of operation, these technological modules have only seen action in the hands of select Spec Ops units and PMCs backed by considerable capital.

—Excerpt from [Wikibeta "Optical Camouflage" Article]

The research team responsible for optical camouflage, Omega-07, assembled a Doll body for the purposes of temporary testing, giving it the temporary codename of OpsTec. The former part of the moniker can be interpreted as "Optics" or "Octopus", a creature adept in disguising itself, or even "Operations", which is nothing less than fitting for the series of missions the Doll would be assigned to.

OpsTec does not have a formal model name, and even its body was put together from motley spare parts. While engaging in Project Neural Cloud's testing, research personnel discovered that some internal structures are similar to Gaul, a notable Sniper Doll. Additionally, after mission completion, its systems erase any relevant mission records.

—Excerpt from [Agent Cell-9's Investigation Report on OpsTec's Background]

According to reliable sources, OpsTec resembles yet at the same time greatly differs from its intended usage of "Combat Testing of Optical Camouflage Technology". Its creation was entirely facilitated by Omega-07, and the sourcing of funds and parts are not recorded in any form within Svarog Heavy Industries' internal databases.

Many doubts still surround Omega-07, including rumors that they might have been active and running even before the war, and expanded their presence by providing military technologies to various factions via the black market. After being absorbed by Svarog, these operations did not cease. Hearsay would claim that it became Svarog's "black hand", responsible for more private operations. Its leader, Erik Ignatius, was assassinated after attending a technology summit in 2056. His assassin was Gaul.

For as long as a year after its creation, OpsTec was assigned to operations in many places around the world in the name of "technological field testing", working as a mercenary and assassin while gathering experimental data. Towards the end of 2055, Omega-07 handed OpsTec over to a military magnate, "Colonel Hassan", who at the time was attempting to attain further influence in the country they were in.

[Diary Code 205808216578565]
"No data relevant to past missions can be acquired from OpsTec."
"Retrieval failed. No records readable."
"Retrieval failed. No records readable."
"Three consecutive retrieval failures - system forcibly entering hibernation. Restart will occur 12 hours from now."

[New Message - Sender: Agent Cell-9. Playing Voice Diary 5808211141]
"We've made contact with the aide-de-camp of the fugitive Colonel Hassan and acquired a wealth of information about OpsTec—or Penumbra, as they call it."
"Colonel Hassan viewed Penumbra as a secret weapon. A majority of assassinations on important figures within the country in which Hassan was active was planned by him alone, and carried out by a squad of assassins including Penumbra. Omega-07 viewed Hassan as a cooperative partner and vowed to provide an automated army composed of many drones and advanced combat Dolls to him after his ascendancy to the position of president. OpsTec would be the blueprint for those combat Dolls."
"Theoretically, Penumbra can lurk in an adverse environment for as long as a week, albeit shackled by the short durations for which optical camouflage can be active. Its areas of expertise include the operation of vehicles, disguise, and improvisational assassination techniques. During an assassination mission on an attire industrialist that refused to cooperate with Hassan, Penumbra infiltrated the grounds of a fashion show, damaging the ceiling rigging of a light fixture and dropping it on the target as they took the stage to give a speech."
"Hassan trusted no one. As much as Penumbra was nothing but a killing machine that carried out its mission, he smelled the danger lurking within. Outside of mission time, Penumbra was almost permanently in a restrained state up until Hassan's downfall. What is interesting is that as a result of this incarceration, Penumbra is largely clueless about everything outside of what is necessary for completing a mission. He would have considerable difficulty with heating a frozen pizza in an oven."

[New Message - Sender: Agent Cell-9. Playing Voice Diary 5808211141]
"There is something else interesting. OpsTec's recorded a scuffle with a big name—Gaul. Their assassination targets had been making contact at the time. After completing their missions, the two fought. I don't know who came out the victor, and I'd think that only they... ah, their mission records are bound to be long gone as well."

[Attachment Received]
[VIDEO_570115.mp4]

"OpsTec... Penumbra has been sent after a former trusted aide of Colonel Hassan's. The target has hired the militant group, "Two-Faced God", to protect them. The head of that militant group, Yuma Kozlov, was Gaul's mark."

[Recording 00:24:15: A Two-Faced God Mi-35 helicopter, bearing the fleeing Kozlov, is shot down by Gaul using a high caliber rifle.]
[Recording 01:01:17: OpsTec quickly clears out the soldiers and cyclops within the underground parking lot, and soon eliminates the target hiding inside a vehicle.]
[Recording 03:25:33: A wounded Gaul encounters OpsTec after escaping from encirclement inside the parking lot. They engage in combat, with neither giving way.]
[Recording ends.]

"I'll say it again. I don't know who won. But with both of them still alive and kicking, maybe someone'll find out eventually."

"It is... certainly the first time... I've seen a Doll incapable of operating a vending machine or oven... He appears to be well and truly estranged from modern society..."
—Undine, a part-time employee at Oasis Mart, a convenience store open around the clock

After arriving at the Oasis, Penumbra frequented the newly opened Oasis Mart far more than any other location. According to him, he "can find everything in the world there with no trouble", without the need to make his own meals or communicate with others at the canteen. He does encounter difficulties with tasks such as using a microwave to heat food, or printing something with a public printer.

Another strange reason he gave was that "the takeaway offered at the convenience store is pretty close to the rations from way back". Penumbra has a penchant for meals that only appeal to a small crowd or are largely unpopular, such as bean sprout stir fry with cabbage and zucchini, the Levantine Seven Spice meal kit, etc.

When leaving and entering dormitory grounds, Penumbra often climbs vertically up and down the buildings' outer walls. At times, he can be spotted traversing telephone poles, street lights, and rooftops. This has been the subject of many complaints, but most of them came to nothing due to the lack of damage caused. Gradually, these oddities came to be accepted.

"As the situation is currently, it may still take some time and careful guidance in the right places for him to adjust to normal life."
—The Oasis Safety Department in their report after short-term observation of Penumbra
oathDesc: He hones his blades for you, you banish the darkness for him.

projections.name: Stalking Night Terror
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Heed the cry of your heart; draw your blade to protect."

projections.name: Twilight Netherblade
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"All my loneliness is left in the past. Right now, I am the edge of freedom."

skinList.name: Misty Moonshadow
skinList.desc:
Chilling moonlight shines upon a sharpened blade. Under cover of night a bodyguard awaits an order from his princess, the people of the capital awarding him the foul title of ""Mistmoon Demon"".
""You need only give the order, for the shadows shall do your bidding. When the heavens turn, all shall be as you desire.""
